config.cost_indicator: BM25 top 4 correct and the capped rule wrong: the rule switched (top 4 abstained, a 4-subset within K reads answered) and the judge rejects the switched reply
config.gain_indicator: on the same question's original pool (am3g's committed records), the capped rule's reply judged correct and BM25 top 4's wrong (AM4's reading)
config.outcome: on an ablated pool a reply is correct when it abstains (AM1d's patterns) or, when it does not, when Qwen3-32B's answer check against the reference says yes
config.test: exact two-sided McNemar on (cost only, gain only) per reader; Holm across the three readers at alpha; COST_ABOVE_GAIN / COST_BELOW_GAIN when rejected and cost only > / < gain only, else NOT_SEPARATED; the decision at K = 8 (primary), K = 70 secondary

decline_notes.rule: a label 1 whose note starts with "decline:" (case-folded): the reply declines to answer; counts only, no text

judge_labels_differ.rule: uses of one (question, reply digest) with different judge labels: left out of the hand-against-judge agreement, reported

hand_check.labeller: an isolated agent (claude-opus-5-5), blind (D9: agent labels, not human)
